business_overview.one_sentence: IGG develops and operates global mobile games and applications, with 2025 revenue mainly from Lords Mobile, Doomsday: Last Survivors, Viking Rise, other games and APP Business.

segments.business_substance: Mature flagship game revenue, 39% of 2025 group revenue.
segments.source: 2025 annual report, Management Discussion and Analysis revenue breakdown, p.6

segments.business_substance: Mid-generation game revenue, 21% of 2025 group revenue.
segments.source: 2025 annual report, Management Discussion and Analysis revenue breakdown, p.6

segments.business_substance: Mid-generation game revenue, 13% of 2025 group revenue.
segments.source: 2025 annual report, Management Discussion and Analysis revenue breakdown, p.6

segments.business_substance: Application business revenue, 19% of 2025 group revenue; disclosed net profit over HK$100 million.
segments.source: 2025 annual report, Management Discussion and Analysis APP Business, p.7

business_overview.revenue_model: Mobile game and APP in-app monetisation distributed globally through third-party payment and app platform channels; trade receivables and funds receivable are generally short-cycle.
business_notes: 2025 revenue by geography: Asia 41%, Europe 36%, North America 19%.
Trade receivables credit terms are generally one to three months.
Funds receivable are balances due from third-party payment service providers for cash collected from users.

financing_liabilities.business_substance: The Group disclosed no bank loans or other borrowings as at 31 December 2025 except lease liabilities.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Trade creditors, salary and welfare payables, other tax payables, other payables and accruals.

other_liabilities.source: 2025 annual report, Statement of Financial Position, p.142

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2024 and 2025 profits converted to cash, but 2023 was weak and 2025 working capital consumed cash through payables and deferred revenue decreases; use the three-year median operating free cash flow as the pre-haircut distributable cash profit and apply a further haircut.

gaps: The annual report discloses cash situated in Chinese Mainland but does not fully split parent-company cash, offshore subsidiaries, all operating subsidiaries and VIE cash.
The annual report does not provide a precise maintenance versus growth split for 2025 capital expenditure; capex is treated conservatively through operating free cash flow.
Market capitalization is taken from the run input rough screen row and was not independently recomputed from live share price in this controlled run.
